message.content: {"note_claim": "No credible reports confirm an Iranian missile strike near Israel's sea area on March 8, 2026 (the video is fictional/AI-generated).", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "Iran fired its first missiles towards Israel on Monday after the appointment of Iran’s new supreme leader, Mojtaba Khamenei, state broadcaster Irib said.", "reason": "The Guardian liveblog covers March 8 events in detail and reports no meteorite or sea-flooding strike, but it does not address the video or directly debunk it, and it reports Iranian missile fire at Israel on March 9."}

parsed.note_claim: No credible reports confirm an Iranian missile strike near Israel's sea area on March 8, 2026 (the video is fictional/AI-generated).
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: Iran fired its first missiles towards Israel on Monday after the appointment of Iran’s new supreme leader, Mojtaba Khamenei, state broadcaster Irib said.
